name: core-timers
description: Timers, named deadlines on an instance (D56): a deadline that starts at the create, at each entry of the status into a state, or at a date-time field, before it with a negative afterMs; the runner's fire schedule, which fires each due deadline once through fireTimer, a keyset past the ones whose fire is refused, per schema and namespace; then's move, from the state the deadline starts in by default, recorded as moved, skipped, vetoed or forbidden; until, which cancels a pending deadline; re-entry, a move away and back within one call included; a snooze and a reset, which a later write keeps, and their permission; the Timers.deadlines field, its events and a Reactions rule that hears a fire; its config, its rule for a new version, deletes and its guidance. Lease beside it is in the work-queue package's lease-timers test.

A deadline not started, or cancelled, is absent. Nothing in it follows the clock: a deadline is overdue while it has not fired and its dueAt has passed.

s32.name: Workflow
s32.description: A state machine on the instance: a status that starts in the initial state and changes only through transition, along a transition the config lists. A transition may name a permission the caller must hold. A state that no transition leaves is terminal, and a terminal state has an outcome: success, failure or neutral, success unless the config says otherwise. Other instances' blockers, rollups and reactions read it.
s32.summary: Its status is one of open, waiting, escalated, resolved and closed; a new Ticket starts in open, and status moves only by transition. Terminal, with their outcomes: closed (success).

shared.s33: Named deadlines on the instance, each due a time after it starts: at the create, each time the status of the type's Workflow enters a state, or at the time a date-time field of the instance holds, before it with a negative offset. A due deadline fires once: it is marked fired and can move the status, from the state it starts in unless the config names others, whatever the move meets. A change of the status can cancel a pending deadline, and a field deadline moves with its field. The engine's runner fires the due deadlines every sweepMs; a caller with the config's permission resets or snoozes one. A deadline that names a state needs Workflow on the type.

behaviors.name: Timers
behaviors.summary: Deadline close is due 30 days after the create; when it fires, it moves the status to closed from open; it is cancelled when the status enters resolved. Deadline remind is due 1 day before the time visitAt holds. Deadline respond is due 4 hours after the status enters open; when it fires, it moves the status to escalated from open; it is cancelled when the status leaves open. behaviors.Timers.deadlines gives each started deadline's dueAt, fired, firedAt and outcome; one not fired is overdue once its dueAt has passed. The runner fires each due deadline within 1 minute, and a deadline stays fired whatever its move meets. A caller with permission tickets.timers may reset or snooze a deadline.

operations.name: create
operations.title: Create Ticket
operations.description: Creates a Ticket: validates the instance, data, against the schema's live version and stores it under id, or under a new id when none is given.

guidance.useWhen: Use to create a new Ticket: data holds its own fields, and id names it, or the engine makes one.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to change one that exists; call update.
guidance.success: Returns the new instance with its id, its seq, its own fields in data and its behaviors' fields in behaviors, by behavior name. A new instance's status is open. A new Ticket starts deadline close, due 30 days later. A visitAt the create gives starts deadline remind.

operations.name: update
operations.title: Update Ticket
operations.description: Applies a JSON merge patch (RFC 7386) to the Ticket with the id: a member replaces the instance's, a nested object merges and null removes a member. With expectedSeq the update is refused unless the instance is still at that sequence.

guidance.useWhen: Use to change the own fields of the Ticket with the id, as a JSON merge patch; with expectedSeq, the update is refused if the instance changed since that seq.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to set a behavior's field: the patch holds own fields only, and a behavior's fields change only through its operations. Do not use to move Workflow's status, which behaviors.Workflow holds; call transition.
guidance.success: Returns the instance as the patch left it, with its next seq. Changing visitAt moves deadline remind, which fires again when it comes due; clearing visitAt cancels it.

operations.name: transition
operations.title: Ticket: transition
operations.description: Moves the instance to another state along a transition the config lists. A transition that names a permission needs a caller who holds it.

from.description: The state the instance was in.

to.description: The state it is in now.

guidance.useWhen: Use to move status from open to waiting, escalated, resolved or closed; from waiting to open, escalated or resolved; from escalated to open or resolved; from resolved to open or closed.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use from closed: no transition leaves a terminal state. Do not use to stay where the instance is.
guidance.success: Returns from and to; status holds to from then on, and enteredAt the time of the move. Entering resolved cancels deadline close. Entering open starts deadline respond, due 4 hours later. Leaving open cancels deadline respond.

fired.description: Whether this call fired the deadline.

outcome.description: When it fired a deadline with then: what the move met.

guidance.useWhen: Use to fire a due deadline at once rather than wait for the runner's sweep.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to move the instance early: on a deadline not due, fired already or not started, the call changes nothing.
guidance.success: Returns fired, whether this call fired the deadline, and with a then the outcome of its move: moved, skipped (the status was not one it moves from), vetoed or forbidden; the deadline is fired whichever.

errors.description: Timers: fireTimer, resetTimer or snoozeTimer of a deadline the config does not name.
errors.commonCorrection: Name a deadline: close, remind or respond.

operations.name: resetTimer
operations.title: Ticket: resetTimer
operations.description: Starts a deadline again from what it starts from now, the create, the status's entry into its state or its field's value, so it is due afterMs after it and not fired: a snooze or a fire is undone. Needs the config's permission; refused for a deadline with nothing to start from now, or whose until holds.

dueAt.description: When it is due, in epoch milliseconds.

guidance.useWhen: Use to start a deadline again from what it starts from now, undoing a snooze or a fire. It needs permission tickets.timers, else the call is forbidden.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to put a deadline off by a time of your choosing; snoozeTimer takes the dueAt.
guidance.success: Returns dueAt, afterMs after what the deadline starts from; it has not fired.

errors.description: Timers: fireTimer, resetTimer or snoozeTimer of a deadline the config does not name.
errors.commonCorrection: Name a deadline: close, remind or respond.

operations.name: snoozeTimer
operations.title: Ticket: snoozeTimer
operations.description: Moves a started deadline's due time to dueAt, and a fired one fires again then. A later write keeps it, until what the deadline starts from changes. Needs the config's permission; refused for a deadline not started, cancelled, or whose until holds.

dueAt.description: When it is due, in epoch milliseconds.

guidance.useWhen: Use to move a started deadline's due time to dueAt, in epoch milliseconds; a fired one fires again then. It needs permission tickets.timers, else the call is forbidden.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use on a deadline that has not started or was cancelled; behaviors.Timers.deadlines lists the started ones.
guidance.success: Returns dueAt. A later write keeps it, until what the deadline starts from changes.

errors.description: Timers: fireTimer, resetTimer or snoozeTimer of a deadline the config does not name.
errors.commonCorrection: Name a deadline: close, remind or respond.

errors.description: Timers: resetTimer of a deadline with nothing to start from now (an enters deadline while the status is in another state, a field deadline whose field holds no date-time), or snoozeTimer of one not started or cancelled; either of a deadline whose until holds.
errors.commonCorrection: None: the deadline has no due time to move. Read behaviors.Timers.deadlines.

behaviors.name: Timers
behaviors.summary: Deadline ping is due atthe time visitAt holds. behaviors.Timers.deadlines gives each started deadline's dueAt, fired, firedAt and outcome; one not fired is overdue once its dueAt has passed. The runner fires each due deadline within 5 seconds, and a deadline stays fired whatever its move meets. Nobody resets or snoozes a deadline: the config names no permission.

operations.name: create
operations.title: Create Ticket
operations.description: Creates a Ticket: validates the instance, data, against the schema's live version and stores it under id, or under a new id when none is given.

guidance.useWhen: Use to create a new Ticket: data holds its own fields, and id names it, or the engine makes one.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to change one that exists; call update.
guidance.success: Returns the new instance with its id, its seq, its own fields in data and its behaviors' fields in behaviors, by behavior name. A new instance's status is open. A visitAt the create gives starts deadline ping.

operations.name: update
operations.title: Update Ticket
operations.description: Applies a JSON merge patch (RFC 7386) to the Ticket with the id: a member replaces the instance's, a nested object merges and null removes a member. With expectedSeq the update is refused unless the instance is still at that sequence.

guidance.useWhen: Use to change the own fields of the Ticket with the id, as a JSON merge patch; with expectedSeq, the update is refused if the instance changed since that seq.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to set a behavior's field: the patch holds own fields only, and a behavior's fields change only through its operations. Do not use to move Workflow's status, which behaviors.Workflow holds; call transition.
guidance.success: Returns the instance as the patch left it, with its next seq. Changing visitAt moves deadline ping, which fires again when it comes due; clearing visitAt cancels it.

operations.name: transition
operations.title: Ticket: transition
operations.description: Moves the instance to another state along a transition the config lists. A transition that names a permission needs a caller who holds it.

from.description: The state the instance was in.

to.description: The state it is in now.
